source: Post-outcome inspection by Package M of original-PDF raster overlays; predictions and references visible.

observations.observation: The first proposed window encloses the isolated ring/speck left of the two-column hatch. Both source readers treat that mark as a speck and the paired hatch as one unit 762; the proposal adds a spurious unit.

The eight windows cover seven drawings. The second window cuts the right end of the ruled compound; the last narrow window encloses only a detached underline dash to the right of the last fish. Underline association and cell bounds split the line incorrectly.
The final eight-tick group, one reference unit 492, is divided across three narrow proposed windows. The other five drawings have one window each, giving eight proposals instead of six.
The first window encloses a tiny isolated mark far left of the nine drawings. The reference excludes it; the proposal emits ten units.
The first window encloses two tiny isolated marks far left of the two three-stroke groups and three following drawings. The reference excludes the marks; the proposal emits six units instead of five.
A single proposed window contains both the curved unit 220 and the adjacent ruled compound 275. Their merger yields ten proposals for eleven reference drawings.

There are seven windows and seven reference drawings, but window 3 cuts the right arm and cell underline of the U. Window 4 starts inside that U and cuts the following fish; window 5 starts inside the preceding fish and cuts the next fish; window 6 starts inside that fish and extends through the final oval. Underline slots overlap drawing boundaries. The four resolved strict top-five misses at units 3–6 therefore begin at unit windows, despite equal counts.

The oval and slashed inner oval lie in a single complete window without an underline. The strict reference is empty because no card matches that drawing and underline state together. This is source/chart coverage uncertainty, not an observed unit-window failure.
The isolated high tick is in one window without an underline. Its strict set was emptied by adjudication after both readers chose 23. The empty strict set cannot score a compatible candidate.
The isolated high tick is in one window without an underline. Its strict set is empty because the chart does not match height, stroke continuity and underline state together.

limitation: Visual review targets the failed top-five rows; it does not independently validate all boundaries of other equal-count rows or estimate an edition-wide error distribution.
